correctness.rationale: The record recurrence r->r-1+least prime nondividing (r-1) and published primorial-copy theorem imply eventual inclusion R subset B_n of periodic residue patterns A_n mod P_n, with density deficit kappa_n-kappa=sum_{j>n}s_j/P_j. The prime-gap bound s_j<=(p_{j+1}-p_j)/2 and Bertrand give deficit <p_{n+1}/(2(p_{n+1}-1)P_n). The indicator pair difference at a fixed shift t is bounded by two one-point differences, yielding existence of Q(t) and 0<=C_n(t)/P_n-Q(t)<p_{n+1}/((p_{n+1}-1)P_n). Independent recurrence enumeration through P8=9699690 reproduces |A8|=2859176, C8(6)=2489664 and certified enclosure 1564931/6096948<Q(6)<=414944/1616615. Q(6)>1/4 whereas kappa^2<=(9/30)^2; strict positive covariance follows. The infinite argument rests on the explicitly credited primorial-copy source theorem; finite n8 is exact only at n8.
